t.zh: 「不下雨，并且刮风」和「不是『又下雨又刮风』」听着相近，意思不同：否定管的范围不一样。写成符号时，范围用括号标出。
t.en: “It is not raining and it is windy” and “it is not the case that it both rains and is windy” sound alike but mean different things: the negation covers a different stretch. In symbols, brackets mark that stretch.

after.zh: 一句话一层层的结构，叫它的语法树。
after.en: The layered structure of a sentence is its syntax tree.

brief.zh: 接一块电路，算出「不是『又下雨又刮风』」在每一行的真值。
brief.en: Wire a board that works out the value of “it is not the case that it both rains and is windy” on every row.

hint.en: Which part does the negation cover?
